prior_summary: Rotated-footprint contract-aware action diffusion. Exact observed margins condition a learned epsilon U-Net. An action-conditioned future-pose/support surrogate supplies masked supervision and low-noise differentiable containment and blue-preservation guidance to denoised action estimates during training. Online actions remain learned DDPM samples, not a controller.
applicable_conditions: The entire assigned expanded finish_red slice: blue may still be held and descending above blue_goal, red may be supported in the buffer, or execution may already be in release, retreat, red approach/closure, lift, transfer, red setdown or terminal retreat. World-frame state poses, wxyz quaternions, joint/finger state and two causal observations are required. Known cube half-size is 0.02 m; square goal half-width is 0.06 m and goal-height tolerance is 0.011 m. Supported modest errors under the demonstrated contact dynamics, not untested large-rotation recovery.
termination_guidance: Evaluate both observed rotated XY footprints and center heights against the supplied goals for one observation. Neither finger release, TCP clearance nor a sustained stop is a task-success requirement. If continuing execution after success, learn the demonstrated finger opening to approximately 0.04 m per finger and TCP retreat toward z=0.300 m without regrasping. A learned mode or outcome probability never overrides observed geometry.
limitations: Training demonstrations are successful, near-centered and near-identity in object orientation. The learned outcome model is only a local surrogate, not IK, collision detection, contact certification or a validated counterfactual simulator. This executable adaptation uses training-time action-gradient guidance and causal mode conditioning rather than online candidate ranking or extra sampling gradients. No images, trajectory-index schedule, per-skill normalization fit or replay are used. No measured policy success is available at design time.

config.architecture: shared-normalized two-state history plus exact geometry -> 256-dimensional MLP context; two causal placement probabilities; 258-conditioned standard epsilon U-Net; action-conditioned residual future-pose/support MLP
config.action_representation: shared-normalized absolute seven joint targets and gripper command
config.normalization: unchanged complete-demonstration shared range normalizer; contract lengths only for nondimensional margins
config.segmentation: all twelve assigned expanded slices unchanged, including shared blue-placement through red-lift transitions
config.guidance_surrogate: detached predictor parameters and context; gradient reaches denoised actions and epsilon network
config.future_masks: future_mask times action mask; exclude already observed slot zero from all outcome labels
config.placement_window: future exact rotated XY containment and height tolerance, separately for each object
config.causal_mode_label: fraction of valid future slots with rotated XY containment and absolute goal-height error no more than 0.05 m
config.support_label: absolute future center-height error at most 0.011 m; geometric proxy, not a contact sensor
config.online_guidance: amortized through trained denoiser and causal geometry/mode conditioning; no extra inference hook
